name: RearmAddMultiRelease
description: Self-sufficient task to add multiple releases to ReARM in one step. No initialize or finalize tasks required. Version must be provided per release.
helpMarkDown:
[Learn more about this task](https://github.com/relizaio/rearm-ado-extension)

The `releases` input accepts a JSON array of release objects. Each object supports the following fields:

```json
[
  {
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "lifecycle": "ASSEMBLED",
    "repoPath": ".",
    "vcsUri": "",
    "vcsDisplayName": "",
    "branch": "",
    "createComponent": false,
    "createComponentName": "",
    "createComponentVersionSchema": "semver",
    "createComponentBranchVersionSchema": "semver",
    "commits": "",
    "releaseArts": [],
    "sceArts": [],
    "runOnCondition": true,
    "datestart": "",
    "dateend": "",
    "deliverables": [
      {
        "odelId": "registry.example.com/myimage",
        "odelType": "CONTAINER",
        "odelDigests": ["sha256:abc123"],
        "odelPurl": "pkg:oci/myimage@sha256:abc123",
        "odelBuildId": "",
        "odelBuildUri": "",
        "odelCiMeta": "azuredevops",
        "odelArtsJson": []
      }
    ]
  }
]
```
author: Reliza Incorporated

inputs.name: rearmApiKeyId
inputs.label: ReARM API Key ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: API Key ID for ReARM authentication

inputs.name: allowRebuild
inputs.label: Allow Rebuild on CI Rerun
inputs.helpMarkDown: Allow rebuilding release on repeated CI reruns. If true, when a release with the same version already exists, it will be rebuilt instead of rejected. Applies to all releases.

inputs.name: releases
inputs.label: Releases JSON
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON array of release objects. Each release must have a 'version' field. See task documentation for the full schema.
